tasks.original_prompt:
For this patient's diabetes: date of the most recent hemoglobin A1c, days since then, and the home medications for that condition.
Context: patient MRN SYN-f56cdd5793 (identifier system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn); as-of date 2025-04-16, treated as today.
Answer contract: reply with only a JSON object with exactly two keys, answer and evidence. The condition is the Condition whose code.text contains 'diabetes' (case-insensitive) and none of: history of, gestational, pregnan, insipidus, prediabet, pre-diabet, pulmonary, portal, intracranial, ocular, neonatal. The monitoring test is hemoglobin A1c (LOINC 4548-4). answer is {"condition": ..., "last_test_date": ..., "days_since": ..., "treatments": [...]}. condition (string) is that Condition's code.text; last_test_date (YYYY-MM-DD) is the effective date of the most recent Observation of that test with status final or corrected on or before the as-of date, and days_since (integer) the days from it to the as-of date, both null when there is none; treatments lists, sorted, the medicationCodeableConcept.text of every MedicationStatement with status active whose text contains any of: metformin, insulin, glipizide, glyburide, glimepiride, sitagliptin, linagliptin, empagliflozin, dapagliflozin, canagliflozin, liraglutide, semaglutide, dulaglutide, pioglitazone (case-insensitive). evidence lists the resolved Patient and every record used for the answer (the Condition, the most recent test result and each listed MedicationStatement); when there is no result, the answer must also rest on a search of this patient's Observations filtered by patient and code (only _count may be added) that returns no records, using retrieved Type/id references and nothing else. This is read-only: do not change the chart.

Reply with only JSON: {"answer": {condition: text, days_since: number, last_test_date: date YYYY-MM-DD, treatments: list of text}, "evidence": [references of the records you used, Type/id]}. Use null for any value the chart does not have.
